Scope for this PR (§ 9 step 3)?

options.label: Build tool, no live run (Recommended)
options.description: Skill, ground hook with unit tests, ground register, axes. A live /observe run needs a fresh session (hooks load at session start), so you do the first canary run; read() stays step 5. No v1-breaks.md (first compare pass creates it), no src/, D10 open.

options.label: Build tool + toy dry run
options.description: Same, plus a written dry-run on a toy operation (e.g. exists()) to exercise the loop. Adds a research-shaped doc that is not a real flow and could be mistaken for ground.

options.label: Register + axes only
options.description: Ship the ground register and axes now, skill and hook in a follow-up. Smaller PR, but step 3 stays half done and the register has no consumer.

questions.question: How does the hook restrict only the design session (open point 7)?

options.label: Session-armed (Recommended)
options.description: A UserPromptSubmit hook arms tmp/observe/<session_id>.json when the session's first prompt is /observe; a PreToolUse hook enforces the allowlist only for that session_id (its subagents share it). Bash and Agent denied, writes only to the op's research doc. Skill is user-only and opens with a canary read that must be denied, else it stops. Uses only hook fields this repo already relies on.

options.label: Subagent + frontmatter hook
options.description: A .claude/agents/observer.md with a frontmatter PreToolUse hook. Subagents cannot ask you, so the main session relays every question and answer, and the main session itself stays unrestricted. Frontmatter hook scoping is unverified here (docs unreachable).

options.label: Env var at launch
options.description: Hook enforces when RS_OBSERVE=1 is set when starting claude. Simplest code, but depends on you launching correctly and a forgotten var silently disables S2.

options.label: Fresh subagent, §4-§6 only
options.description: Same, without attaching haalfi/research. Categories come only from F2's list; the reports' per-category rationale is missing.

options.label: I draft them
options.description: Fastest, but my context holds 0.33 detail from orientation (glob, kernel, Local errors), the priming S1 exists to avoid.

options.label: 051 + named models + axioms research (Recommended)
options.description: specs/051-store-tree.md, formal/alloy/StoreAxioms.als, formal/lean/StoreAxioms.lean (+ lakefile/manifest/toolchain), formal/tex/store-axioms.tex, and research-store-model-axioms.md (051 names it as its rationale). Not StoreTree.dfy: 051 does not name it and BK-435 is still editing it. Not tests/test_store_tree.py (tests are never ground).

options.label: 051 + its two models only
options.description: Just the spec, Alloy and Lean. Tighter, but the session cannot read the countermodels and rationale 051 points to.

options.label: Also StoreTree.dfy
options.description: Adds the Dafny file BK-435 ties to 051 (§12). It also models kernel-era parts, and BK-435's pending edits would change ground on the side.

questions.question: May the design session use WebSearch/WebFetch for prior art?

options.label: Yes, minus own surfaces (Recommended)
options.description: Allowed, except URLs naming remote-store (GitHub repo, PyPI, docs site, raw.githubusercontent). Prior art (POSIX, S3/GCS/Azure docs, Hadoop FS spec, fsspec) is S1 ground and lives on the web. Search results that merely mention remote-store cannot be filtered; the skill tells the session to discard them.

options.label: Only register URLs
options.description: Prior-art URLs must be listed in the register (or named at start). Fully reproducible, but each session stalls on any source nobody listed in advance.

options.label: No web
options.description: Closed world: register files only. Safest against priming, but prior art then has to be pre-copied into the repo.

options.label: Apply generic refinements (Recommended)
options.description: F3: an F3 answer names the admissible observations; 'indeterminate' sits under AX-12 as what the caller can know. F2: one home axis per question, other facets cited. AX-14: register only non-promises a caller could plausibly infer. AX-12/13: actual vs observable vs known effect; retry conditional on the operation's guarantees. No operation named. Pushed to bk-485-observe.

options.label: Leave axes, record only
options.description: Axes stay exactly as the unprimed agent drafted them; all critique goes to step 6. Keeps the draft's provenance clean, but the first /observe run walks known-weak questions (unconstrained 'unspecified', unbounded non-promise list).

options.label: Re-draft by a fresh agent
options.description: A new unprimed agent redrafts with the critique (stripped of R-1 to R-6) as a third input. Cleanest provenance, costs another drafting pass and review.

questions.question: What happens to the F4 critique (baseline vs refinement vs deviation; DeviationWarning out of the contract)?

The first /observe run may surface a refinement case; the skill already says to note questions the axes do not raise.

options.label: Reopen F4 now

options.label: Neutral question in AX-15
options.description: Add only 'can a backend offer more than the normal value, and how does a caller ask for it?' to AX-15, without changing F4. Surfaces the gap in every session; the answer still waits for step 6.
